title: Diagnose, repair, recheck
target: Identify a reasoning error and demonstrate the repaired method on a new problem.
criteria: Show a corrected method with units.
Apply the repair to a different problem.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A student finds acceleration under 21 N right and 6 N left by dividing 21 by mass. Which is the first incorrect step?
options: Using one force instead of the net force.
cpa.guide: First combine signed forces: net is 15 N right.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: A robot moves from x = 5 m to x = 17 m in 4 s. A student reports average velocity 17/4 m/s. What did the student omit?
cpa.guide: Average velocity uses displacement, not final position alone.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: A 3 kg cart has 21 N right and 6 N left. What is corrected acceleration?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A robot moves from 5 m to 17 m in 4 s. What is corrected average velocity?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: In a new case, a 4 kg cart has 8 N right and 28 N left. Apply the repaired force method.
cpa.guide: Net = 20 N left; divide by 4 kg.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A different rover goes from −4 m to +11 m in 3 s. Which calculation correctly transfers the repaired position method?
cpa.guide: Subtract the signed initial coordinate before dividing by elapsed time.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.
